coolhunting.title: The Office
coolhunting.notes: Adds three Dispatch pieces (Citrus Commons, the former Sunkist headquarters in Los Angeles that KFA and IMT Residential are landmarking and converting from brutalist office into 95 apartments under LA's expanded Adaptive Reuse Ordinance — the reuse argument's office-to-housing direction; the RIBA Reinvention Award's four-project shortlist, including Space House, a listed 1960s office restored as a workplace, and a Buttermarket entry that overlaps with the Stephen Lawrence Prize shortlist; and the Kennedy Center demolition threat, where a DOJ court filing frames a contested renovation dispute in structural-necessity language with no published assessment behind it, read against this issue's Rike Concert Hall dispatch). Retires the Stirling Prize shortlist dispatch (16 July), now past six weeks old; its argument continues via the new Reinvention Award piece. Adds one organiser-confirmed calendar date: the World Architecture Festival in Fort Lauderdale (18–20 November 2026).
